name: Linux Hardening Assessment
description: Focused assessment of Linux and Unix-like system hardening configurations. Covers systemd service hardening, PAM configuration review, sysctl security tuning, mandatory access controls (SELinux and AppArmor policy assessment), SSH hardening, audit framework configuration (auditd, auditctl, aureport), file integrity monitoring, partition and mount security, and CIS Distribution-specific Benchmark compliance.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Linux hardening assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Linux hardening principles and common security baselines
evidence: Can explain Linux DAC, file permissions, and the principle of least privilege
Familiar with CIS Distribution Benchmarks (Ubuntu, RHEL, SUSE) structure
Understands systemd service sandboxing options and SELinux/AppArmor concepts
Completed introductory training on Linux security hardening

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs Linux hardening assessment tools and reviews configurations under supervision
evidence: Runs Lynis, OpenSCAP, or CIS-CAT against Linux systems under guidance
Reviews SSH configuration, PAM modules, and sysctl parameters using checklists
Assesses file permissions on sensitive files and SUID/SGID binaries
Documents findings with supervision and produces basic hardening reports

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Linux hardening and provides contextualized remediation
evidence: Independently assesses Linux servers against CIS benchmarks for 2+ distributions
Evaluates SELinux or AppArmor policy effectiveness in context of server role
Assesses auditd configuration completeness and systemd service hardening
Produces compliant hardening assessment reports with risk-prioritized remediation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops custom Linux hardening baselines; handles complex environments
evidence: Develops organization-specific Linux hardening baselines for different server roles
Assesses complex environments with mixed distributions and legacy systems
Automates compliance checking with OpenSCAP profiles or custom tooling
Reviews hardening assessment work of junior analysts

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Linux hardening methodology; contributes to industry standards
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Linux hardening assessment framework
Contributes to CIS Benchmark development for Linux distributions
Trains teams on advanced Linux hardening assessment across multiple distributions
Recognized as authority on Linux security baseline configuration

assessment_methods.description: Assess a set of Linux servers (Ubuntu and RHEL) with varying hardening levels and produce a prioritized findings report with distribution-specific remediation
Review Linux hardening assessment findings and remediation guidance from recent engagements

cis: CIS Red Hat Enterprise Linux Benchmark
